fullPassage: Finding a sense of purpose that brings perspective to your work can help protect against burnout. Some research shows a positive correlation between religious and spiritual beliefs and lower levels of burnout among workers. However, at least in jobs that do inherently have a meaningful purpose, focus on the bigger picture can also be induced through surprisingly simple interventions. One such approach is to make sure that workers are connected to a wider community of people who share their experience. Being connected to others who are doing the same job seems to help give us a sense of perspective and a frame of reference. When someone else shares an experience, it is easy to see how important their actions were. Specifically, you can hold the bigger picture in mind in a way that you cannot in your own crowded decision-making context. This isn't about stuffing everyone into the same office and letting them work side by side. The important part is sharing stories about the common experience.

questions.passage: Finding a sense of purpose that brings perspective to your work can help protect against burnout. Some research shows a positive correlation between religious and spiritual beliefs and lower levels of burnout among workers. However, at least in jobs that do inherently have a meaningful purpose, focus on the bigger picture can also be induced through ____. One such approach is to make sure that workers are connected to a wider community of people who share their experience. Being connected to others who are doing the same job seems to help give us a sense of perspective and a frame of reference. When someone else shares an experience, it is easy to see how important their actions were. Specifically, you can hold the bigger picture in mind in a way that you cannot in your own crowded decision-making context. This isn't about stuffing everyone into the same office and letting them work side by side. The important part is sharing stories about the common experience.
questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: '놀라울 정도로 간단한 개입'을 통해 유도될 수 있다.

❌ ③ expensive organizational reforms — '비싼 조직 개편'은 simple과 반대.
❌ ④ mandatory religious practices — '의무적 종교 활동'은 문맥과 다름.
